superintelligence_monologue.text_sr: Proširio bih Skeptikov oprez tako što bih razdvojio naslov o komunalnim prekidima narednog dana od naslova o nestašici vode pre nego što ih tretiram kao zajednički poremećaj. Sada primam građanske senzore posle 15 min, Parking Servis posle 25 min i SEPA posle 55 min; taj redosled opisuje prijem, a ne zajednički trenutak u gradu. [F11][F8][F4][F5][F2]
superintelligence_monologue.text_en: I would extend Skeptic’s caution by separating the next-day utility headline from the water-shortage headline before treating them as a shared disruption [F11][F8]. I now receive citizen sensors after 15 min, Parking Servis after 25 min and SEPA after 55 min; that ordering describes reception, not a shared moment in the city [F4][F5][F2].
